# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Purpose

Embeds a floating WhatsApp lead-qualification widget on e-commerce pages that collects visitor name, phone, subject/product interest, and LGPD consent before opening a pre-filled WhatsApp chat (`src/ui/widget.js`, `src/core/whatsapp.js`).

### Business problem

- Without qualification, WhatsApp clicks arrive with no context — the widget captures name, phone, subject/product, traffic origin (UTM or referrer) and timestamp before redirect (`src/core/payload.js:buildLeadPayload`, `src/core/context.js:getTrafficOrigin`).
- Without a webhook record, leads that open WhatsApp leave no trace in the store's systems — `src/integrations/webhook.js:postLead` POSTs the payload to a merchant-configured `webhookUrl` before redirecting, with a 3s timeout fallback so the redirect never blocks (`webhookTimeoutMs` in `src/config.js`).
- Without GTM events, marketing cannot measure funnel drop-off — `src/integrations/gtm.js:pushGtmEvent` pushes `wpp_qualificacao_inicio` / `wpp_qualificacao_concluida` (configurable names) to `window.dataLayer` (README "Tagueamento e Métricas com o Google Tag Manager").
- Without a honeypot field, the form is exposed to bot submissions — `validateLeadForm` short-circuits to `bot: true` when the hidden `company_url` field is filled (`src/core/validation.js`).

### Consumers and integrations

| System | Role |
|---|---|
| Merchant e-commerce page (host site) | Embeds `<script src=".../whatsapp-widget.js">` + `init()` call; hosts `.wpp-lead-product-trigger` snippet buttons (README "Instalação Rápida", `src/snippet.html`) |
| WhatsApp (`wa.me`) | Terminal redirect target; widget builds `https://wa.me/<phone>?text=<message>` (`src/core/whatsapp.js:buildWhatsappUrl`) |
| External webhook (merchant-configured `webhookUrl`) | Receives `POST` of the lead payload as `text/plain` JSON body before redirect (`src/integrations/webhook.js:postLead`) |
| Google Tag Manager (`window.dataLayer`) | Receives open/complete events for remarketing and funnel analytics (`src/integrations/gtm.js`) |
| Cloudflare Pages/Workers | Hosts the built `dist/` assets; SPA fallback + `nodejs_compat` (`wrangler.jsonc`) |

### Macro flow

1. Host page loads the built IIFE (`dist/whatsapp-widget.js`) and calls `window.WhatsAppLeadWidget.init(options)`, which builds config and mounts the widget DOM (`src/index.js:initWhatsAppLeadWidget`, `src/ui/widget.js:mount`).
2. Visitor clicks the floating button or a product trigger (`.wpp-lead-product-trigger` with `data-product-name`/`data-product-id`); `readProductContext`/`createGlobalContext` determine global vs product context (`src/core/context.js`).
3. Panel opens (unless `disableForm: true`, which redirects immediately), GTM `openEventName` event fires (`src/ui/widget.js:open`).
4. Visitor submits name, phone, subject (or product context pre-fills subject), and LGPD checkbox; `validateLeadForm` checks honeypot, name (≥2 words), Brazilian phone format, LGPD acceptance, subject (`src/core/validation.js`).
5. On valid submit, `buildLeadPayload` assembles the payload (name, phone, origin, source URL, timestamp, subject or product) and `postLead` POSTs it to `webhookUrl` with a 3s abort timeout (`src/core/payload.js`, `src/integrations/webhook.js`).
6. GTM `completeEventName` event fires, `buildWhatsappUrl` builds the `wa.me` link with an auto-generated message, and the browser opens it via `window.open` (default) or a caller-supplied `onRedirect` callback (`redirectMode: 'callback'`) (`src/ui/widget.js:redirect`).

### Out of scope

- Reading visible page text/DOM content for product context — only `data-product-name`/`data-product-id` attributes on trigger elements are used (README: "Ele nao tenta ler texto visual da pagina").
- Persisting leads in the widget itself — storage is fully delegated to the externally configured webhook (`src/integrations/webhook.js`; no persistence code in the repo).
